HOME SCIENCE — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #1
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: HOME SCIENCE
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water always increases oxygen
   B. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   C. Water removes heat too quickly
   D. Petrol fires have no fuel

2. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Food Preservation? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Food Preservation.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Food Preservation.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Food Preservation.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Food Preservation.

3. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Time and Energy Management 2.3 Control of Household Pests and Insects 2.4 Launde? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Time and Energy Management 2.3 Control of Household Pests and Insects 2.4 Launde.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Time and Energy Management 2.3 Control of Household Pests and Insects 2.4 Launde.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Time and Energy Management 2.3 Control of Household Pests and Insects 2.4 Launde.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Time and Energy Management 2.3 Control of Household Pests and Insects 2.4 Launde.

4. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 100 °C
   B. 0 °C
   C. 37 °C
   D. 50 °C

5. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Only carbon dioxide
   B. Only water vapour
   C. Nitrogen gas only
   D. Glucose and oxygen

6. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Meal Service? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Meal Service.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Meal Service.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Meal Service.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Meal Service.

7. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Personal Appearance and Etiquette? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Personal Appearance and Etiquette.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Personal Appearance and Etiquette.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Personal Appearance and Etiquette.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Personal Appearance and Etiquette.

8. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   B. Removing all vegetation
   C. Overgrazing continuously
   D. Burning crop residue every week

9. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Personal Appearance and Etiquette 2.2 Time and Energy Management 2.3 Control of ? (1 mark)

   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Personal Appearance and Etiquette 2.2 Time and Energy Management 2.3 Control of .

10. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. Movement of water only across a membrane
   B. A chemical reaction forming ash
   C. Heating until a solid melts
   D. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration

11. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Control of Household Pests and Insects 2.4 Laundering of Fabrics 2.5 Interior De? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Control of Household Pests and Insects 2.4 Laundering of Fabrics 2.5 Interior De.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Control of Household Pests and Insects 2.4 Laundering of Fabrics 2.5 Interior De.

   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Control of Household Pests and Insects 2.4 Laundering of Fabrics 2.5 Interior De.

12. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Laundering of Fabrics 2.5 Interior Decoration 2.6 Budgeting 3.0 Clothing and Tex? (1 mark)

   D. Guess results without recording observations on Laundering of Fabrics 2.5 Interior Decoration 2.6 Budgeting 3.0 Clothing and Tex.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
